'''''Lagunaria patersonia''''' is a [[species]] of tree in the family [[Malvaceae]].<ref name=POWO_561145-1/> It is commonly known as the '''pyramid tree''', '''Norfolk Island hibiscus''', '''Queensland white oak''', '''sally wood''',<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.anbg.gov.au/cgi-bin/apni |title=Australian Plant Names Index |accessdate=14 January 2014 |archive-date=2013-02-12  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130212165009/http://anbg.gov.au/cgi-bin/apni |url-status=dead }}</ref> or simply as '''white oak''' on [[Norfolk Island]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.environment.gov.au/topics/national-parks/norfolk-island-national-park/natural-environment/flora|accessdate=2015-01-14|publisher=Australia Department of the Environment|title=Norfolk Island > Natural Environment > Flora}}</ref> Its seed capsules are filled with irritating hairs giving rise to common names, '''itchy bomb tree''',<ref>{{cite book |publisher=Kiama Municipal Council |title=Tree Management Procedure For Trees On Public Land |year=2009}}</ref> and '''cow itch tree'''.
